arguments.text: Additional arguments passed to all.equal. tol is a prefix of tolerance.

origin.details: True when isTRUE(all.equal(x, y)) is true. The default tolerance is sqrt(.Machine$double.eps). NA equals NA, and NULL equals NULL.

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Passed to the numeric comparison. tol is a prefix of tolerance.

translation.details: True when the two values agree under the numeric all.equal rule. The default tolerance is the square root of math.ulp(1.0). NA equals NA, and None equals None.
translation.example:
from assertthat import see_if

x = 2
print(see_if("are_equal(x, 1.9)"))
print(see_if("are_equal(x, 1.999, tol = 0.01)"))
print(see_if("are_equal(x, 2)"))
